_comment: nuclei-style templated web checks (backlog Wave 2). Each template GETs `path` on a discovered web service and reports a hit when the matchers pass: `status` (any of the listed codes) AND `body_contains` (any of the listed substrings). Optional `match_server` limits the template to ports whose fingerprinted Server header contains one of the listed strings (case-insensitive) -- omit it to fire everywhere. Extend freely -- this is JSON (stdlib, no pyyaml dep) rather than nuclei's YAML, but the same idea. High-signal, low-false-positive exposures only.
